title: Output Schema for Acknowledge Message Operation
description: Output schema for the Solace acknowledgeMessage operation.

payload.description: The main response payload from the acknowledgeMessage operation.

settled.description: Whether the inbound message was settled with the broker.

outcome.description: The settlement outcome applied to the message (always ACK for this operation).

ackMessageId.description: The broker-assigned ack message id of the settled message. Present only when the message carried a non-zero ack message id.

settledAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the message was settled.

settled.description: Whether the inbound message was settled with the broker.

outcome.description: The settlement outcome applied to the message (always ACK for this operation).

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
